domains: goals nested under objectives (daily living, social interactions, recreational); task domains reading, mobility, visual information, visual motor
response_scale: goal importance 4-point; difficulty 5-point (not difficult to impossible without assistance)
scoring: Rasch person measures (logits, Winsteps 3.69.143) at goal level, task level and per domain; higher = greater visual ability
notes: UK-adapted version of 30 goals and 235 tasks (Table 1 p2; some original goals dropped); adaptive testing; typical administration approximately 35 minutes (p2); psychometrics of the AI itself not reported in this paper
Rasch person separation 1.1 (Table 5 p5); psychosocial covariate, not an LVR screening instrument

domains: self-esteem; attitudes; locus of control; self-efficacy; acceptance

full_name: Neuroticism, Extraversion, Openness Five Factor Inventory
